verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.ashbyhq.com, and it tells agents to append .md to any docs page for a markdown version. The markdown pages also resolve: the API introduction and the authentication and webhook docs all load as .md, and the introduction points back to the full documentation index. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths return 404), no first-party guidance on using these docs with agents, and the llms.txt content looks thin and generic.
